name: BUGSKILL
summary:
⚠️ **WARNING:** Your home has been overrun by a swarm of pesky flies!

Train your reflexes and get ready for a workout – these flies have mapped out every corner of your space, and you've only got 30 seconds each round to hunt them down!

💥 **Slap every surface within reach and clap your hands with precision!**
